dedupe_keys.name: project rise industrial smoke video dataset and baselines

description: Project RISE publishes labelled industrial-smoke videos and baseline recognition code from CMU CREATE Lab and collaborators. The documented dataset contains 12,567 clips from 19 camera views at three industrial-monitoring sites, sampled on 30 daytime dates across four seasons in 2018 and 2019. JSON metadata describe camera views, clip times and annotation states, with training and test splits by date or view. Data are free under CC0; accompanying model code is BSD-3-Clause. A limitation is that volunteer and researcher labels need the documented quality filters, and smoke recognition is not a measurement of pollutant concentration. The authors also report a corrected non-local-block implementation and an incorrect original RGB-NL paper result. The resource can calibrate emission-observation components of industrial simulations. CEDS (platform-ceds) supplies related inventory-scale emissions processing. This parent record includes the published baseline models and training workflow. No video, measurement file or model weights were downloaded.
